thread_text:
Ethan Morales: Hey team! Ethan here, started today on Eng-Platform. Laptop arrived, trying to get VPN + MDM sorted. Also: who do I ping for Git org access and an SSH review? For fun: two truths and a lie about me — 1) I climbed Mt. Fuji, 2) I play cello in a community orchestra, 3) I'm allergic to chocolate. Guess which is the lie?

Priya Rao: Welcome Ethan!! 389 I'm your manager. I'll add you to the repo list, and @Jules can sort device enroll + VPN. Coffee chat later this week?

Jules (IT): Hi Ethan, Jules from IT. Can you confirm OS and device serial? If Jamf email missing I'll resend. For VPN try installing the client here: https://intranet.redwood/vpn-client and ping me when done.

Ethan Morales: macOS Monterey, serial is C02XK1ABCDE. Jamf email didn't come through.

Jules (IT): Got it — resending enrollment now and manually approving your device. Expect an invite in ~5 mins.

Kara - eng-platform: Hey Ethan, I'm your onboarding buddy. For Git org access, open the new-hire access form and paste your SSH pub key. If you want, drop the key here and I'll add the team perms. Example: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "ethan.morales@redwood.com"`

Ethan Morales: Dropped the pub key in the form. Thanks Kara. Also yes to coffee chat 375

Onboard Bot: Reminder 514 - Complete security training within 3 days: https://intranet.redwood/security-training

Marta (HR): Welcome! Don't forget benefits enrollment and payroll setup. Ping me if anything times out. Also we mail stickers — DM preferred address.

Ethan Morales: Quick update: Jamf invite came through and device enrolled. VPN connected. Thanks everyone. Also, my lie is that I'm allergic to chocolate 36b — I'm definitely not. Looking forward to working with you all!

Priya Rao: Mystery solved 60a Welcome aboard Ethan, excited to have you on Eng-Platform. We'll set up a short 1:1 later today.

Kara - eng-platform: Adding you to #eng-platform now. We'll do a quick repo walkthrough tomorrow. Welcome again! 680
